Completes `xboing-c-xzt`, open since 2026-05-02.

The bead asked for **Write + Bash**. Write was granted at some point; Bash never was. Last time I fixed only the stale doc that wrongly called jck read-only, and left the actual capability gap — half the work.

Without Bash, jck can't run `ethos mission result`, so the COO scribes every research and design result on his behalf. That's the failure the bead was filed about, seen in `m-2026-05-02-002` and again in the `m-2026-07-17` work.

`vision-keeper.yaml` gains `Bash`; `delegation.md`'s tool list updated to match so the two don't drift apart again — which is exactly how this bead became half-true.

Verified: `ethos doctor` exits 0, `make lint` 0 errors, `delegation.md` 81 lines against its `< 100` budget.

Closes `xboing-c-xzt`.
